source.notes: Paper with a real text layer (the icseboard.org watermark letters interleave with it; text checked against the page images). The paper covers Physics (Section-A), Chemistry (Section-B) and Biology (Section-C), 20 marks each, M.M: 60, Time-3 hours; this pack holds only Section-B (Chemistry). No year is printed on the paper; examYear 2021 is taken from the file name (…-230922-2021). The header prints "Assessment-11" (presumably Assessment-II). Marks per question are not printed; the values used are inferred from the section total and flagged on each question. Items in "Any three"/"Any two" groups are all listed, so the marks total exceeds 20. The WhatsApp/Paytm advertisement on page 4 is ignored. Topics with no matching class-6 chemistry chapter (fibres, medicines/drugs, detergents, polymers) have chapter null.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
